2837.text: Taken literally (epi-ousios: "super-essential"), it refers directly to the Bread of Life, the Body of Christ, the "medicine of immortality," without which we have no life within us.
2837.notes: One sentence only; 'it' = the word 'daily' (epiousios). catholicdoors.com truncates before 'without which'. Ch 10 line 235.
